notes: Upstream means an ordinary declared version requirement or pin; this audit does not claim it is the newest published release.
The kernel vendor futures-util 0.3.32 satisfies the built-ins 0.3 requirement, but differs from kernel Cargo.lock 0.3.34. Wiring must select the intended source.
rand 0.10 is a normal upstream dependency. Kernel Cargo.lock rand 0.8.8 is not a substitute; both versions can coexist.
The registry dependencies can themselves use transitive TrueOS overlays. Those are outside this direct-dependency audit.
No TrueOS package verification was run.

Seven remaining vendor source trees were initially copied unchanged from the recorded Blueprints commit; the entire winit workspace was retained at its recorded submodule commit. Git metadata was excluded. The trueos SDK was subsequently copied to vendor/trueos together with vendor/trueos-v and vendor/trueos-math from the same commit. Only the SDK internal v path was adjusted; built-in Cargo paths/patches remain unchanged.

Two Luna agents reviewed the six vendor packages other than winit. Isolated crossterm Windows backends and Tokio Windows named-pipe/signal APIs were removed; shared Linux/Unix implementations and uncertain adapters were retained. Parent independently checked modified syntax and preservation of Unix/TrueOS-specific source.

kernel_build_workflow.integration: TRUEOS/tools/trueos-boot/prepare.sh builds the complete set before the final kernel build; build.rs verifies and embeds normal TRBP packages into the existing app.db seed.

std_port.note: Applied only to a private rust-src copy, followed by the kernel-owned thread/TLS backend installer.

kernel_build_workflow.source_note: Additional sources come from the recorded original_blueprints commit. The original std adaptations were applied to Hyper-util and Tower. Local paths in http-body-util, Hyper and winit-trueos now resolve to the sibling kernel or vendored API. Kernel http, http-body, crc32fast, futures-util, ring and want remain shared.
kernel_build_workflow.compatibility_correction: Matching crate versions do not guarantee matching platform APIs: the Blueprint mio and Hyper forks use std I/O, while the kernel versions use no_std I/O; Blueprint httpdate supplies std-system-time. These require their own vendored copies here.

getrandom.reason: ring and rand_core 0.6 require the 0.2 API, while ahash 0.8 and lightningcss pin 0.3. Removing these adapters needs wider upstream dependency migrations. Only TrueOS byte filling is shared; dispatch, other platforms and versioned public APIs are unchanged.
